articles.title: Unsloth Fixes Arbitrary Code Execution Flaw Triggered by Malicious Hugging Face Models
articles.summary:
Unsloth has addressed a critical arbitrary code execution vulnerability in its Studio web interface. This flaw allowed a malicious Hugging Face model repository to execute attacker-controlled Python code simply by a user selecting or inspecting it. articles.summary:
